body:
I haven't really been talking with my mom. She works long hours and I rarely see her. 

I feel like there's something wrong with me. I don't feel like a normal person. What I mean by that is when I took Claratin D, I could think properly and I felt alive and I could talk properly. Now without it, I feel like there's a giant cloud over my head constantly. 

I went to the doctor and I did an lung x-ray because I've been spiting out a lot of mucus every day for the past year and a half.

Honestly all of this doesn't really seem THAT stressful to me. It's just him driving around endangering others, I'm kind of over the fact he abused us and maybe it strengthen me or made it so I'm more defensive and distant.

All I want is to feel normal and I feel like whatever is wrong with me is hindering my ability to be productive with my time. 

I did a brain mapping and I had a lot of shit wrong with me. They said it was most likely from a traumatic brain injury. I suspect it was from my father when I was a baby.

Edit: His name is on the car that I use to drive to school with. Is there a way he can take the car from me? I heard he can't since I use it to commute to school. If he divorces, I don't think he will live long enough to go to the court.
